svg.title: 16 / Everyday actions should feel obvious
svg.desc: Visible filters, a clear typed cell editor, and status that separates a view from its underlying dataset.. Design proposal, not a runtime screenshot. All dataset values and counts are synthetic illustrations. See README for capability boundaries and sources.
svg.text: Visible filters, a clear typed cell editor, and status that separates a view from its underlying dataset.
DESIGN GUIDANCE ONLY • synthetic data • no runtime changes • sources and acceptance notes in README.md
Changes the view, not source bytes.
Illustrated before Apply: the table below still shows the unfiltered 12-row view. After Apply, show only matches.
Rows 1–5 of 12 · logical row identity retained
Typed scalar draft; unsupported lossless types remain read-only.
Enter commits · Esc cancels · empty string is not NULL
Validation / comparison results become stale after an accepted edit.
State text belongs beside the affected view.
Export still writes the full edited dataset.
Field, operator and typed value stay visible together.
Editable filter rows must apply the values they display.
Grid arrows must not hijack native text editing keys.
A rejected draft never partially mutates the overlay.
03 Focus is part of the action
Visible cell ring, announced apply/copy outcomes.
Scroll to the logical row; never target by visual index.
